note: SAME DRAWING, DIFFERENT SCAN, DIFFERENT PIXEL SPACE. This is not a new source about 1834 Chicago: it is a second raster of the drawing this project already traces as `wright_1834` (the BPL/Leventhal copy, commonwealth:js957744g, 4204 x 5166 px). Nothing may be cited from it by BPL pixel coordinates and nothing may be cited from the BPL scan by this one's — the two frames are registered to each other in data/traces/gcp/wright_1834_nara_hup_gcps.json and differ by 8.5 px RMS and by up to 19 px (13 m) locally. WHAT IT IS FOR: at 600 dpi it resolves ink the BPL scan does not, and the block numerals of the Original Town are legible on it where they are not on the BPL sheet (T-0788). WHAT IT COSTS: the sheet carries two losses of paper, boxed in the registration file, and the drawing was at one time torn from the upper right margin and mounted on cloth; anything read inside a lacuna box is read from cloth, not from Wright. The published caption's own words are transcribed in the registration file.
what_it_supplies: block numerals of the Original Town, legible at 600 dpi
what_it_does_not_supply: anything inside the two boxed lacunae
an independent survey — it is the same drawing as wright_1834 and is never a second witness to it
